source.name: RomaPress - Roma secure main sponsorship agreement with Eurobet: the club will earn €16 million per year
source.quote: Roma will receive €16 million per year from the agreement, which is valid for three years and four months.

note: Multi-year deal running to the 2028/29 season per the club's announcement. Value is a press report; another report (Yahoo/Football Italia, 2026-03-11) gives the same €16m figure. Two other variants exist: Goal (2026-03-18) reported €8m for the first season rising to €13m, and iGaming Republic (2026-03-16, citing Il Tempo via Calcio e Finanza) reported €13-14m base with bonuses to around €16m - see PR.
